# Image upload pipeline

*Client industry: printing | Completed: 2023-12-22 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p14*

## The problem
The client was a print shop losing customer files.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using a JavaScript backend, AWS, a JSON HTTP API, containerised deployment. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project handled 50k uploads a month without loss.
